morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中整个人名作为独立单位使用，不分析为马来语词根与词缀。IPA 表示该角色名字的常见英语读法，并非马来语规范读音；输入缺失的分音节和 Jawi 保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 蕾妮斯梅：斯蒂芬妮·梅尔为《暮光之城》系列创造的女性角色名字，指贝拉与爱德华的女儿。
senses.en_definition: A feminine name coined by Stephenie Meyer for Bella and Edward's daughter in the Twilight series.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang dicipta oleh Stephenie Meyer untuk anak perempuan Bella dan Edward dalam siri Twilight.
senses.nuances: 正常书写为 Renesmee，属于外来专名，不具有已核实的马来语普通词义。输入未提供 DBP 释义；此处为人物说明。下列为人物名称组合，不宣称是经语料统计确认的高频搭配。角色与命名背景见 [作者的 Breaking Dawn 问答](https://stepheniemeyer.com/the-books/breaking-dawn/frequently-asked-questions-breaking-dawn/)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pembentangan itu membincangkan peranan Renesmee dalam hubungan antara Bella dengan Edward.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该报告讨论了蕾妮斯梅在贝拉与爱德华关系中的作用。
dual_scenarios.en: The presentation discussed Renesmee's role in Bella and Edward's relationship.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Renesmee tu anak Bella dengan Edward, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Renesmee itu anak Bella dan Edward, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 蕾妮斯梅就是贝拉和爱德华的孩子，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: Renesmee is Bella and Edward's daughter, right?

etymology.historical_story: Stephenie Meyer says she invented Renesmee because an existing human name did not suit the unusual fictional child she imagined. She dates the naming to autumn 2003. This makes the name an example of literary invention circulating internationally through a story, rather than a word inherited from Malay vocabulary. [Stephenie Meyer](https://stepheniemeyer.com/the-books/breaking-dawn/frequently-asked-questions-breaking-dawn/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按常见英语读法记成 rə–NEZ–may，再联想贝拉与爱德华的女儿；整体记人名，不拆成马来语词缀。
